cohort: Pregnant rabbits and their fetuses in a model of surgically induced intrauterine growth restriction (IUGR).
finding: Intra-amniotic nutritional supplementation significantly improved survival in IUGR fetuses compared to non-treated IUGR animals, but did not significantly affect birth weight or fetal cardiac function.
birth_weight: Controls mean 43g, IUGR mean 36g, IUGR-T mean 35g
gest_age: Gestational day 25 at IUGR induction and treatment
